categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment and general semiconductor equipment. Its main product lines include plasma etching equipment, MOCVD equipment for compound semiconductors, thin film deposition equipment, and environmental protection equipment. It serves integrated circuit manufacturing, advanced packaging, LED epitaxial wafer production, power devices, MEMS, and other microfabrication fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced plasma etching (CCP and ICP), MOCVD for GaN-based LEDs and power devices, LPCVD and ALD thin film deposition, and epitaxial growth equipment for silicon and germanium-silicon. The company emphasizes dual-chamber designs, adjustable electrode spacing, ultra-high aspect ratio etching, and energy-efficient MOCVD systems. It follows a matrix R&D management model with independent teams for different product lines and shared engineering resources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global semiconductor manufacturers producing integrated circuits at advanced nodes (down to 5nm and below), LED epitaxial wafer producers, power device manufacturers, MEMS producers, and advanced packaging companies. The company’s equipment is used in logic, DRAM, 3D NAND, power electronics, and emerging display technologies like Mini-LED and Micro-LED.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China, with significant sales and support presence in Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, the United States, Europe, and other international markets. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Shanghai, Nanchang, Guangzhou, Xiamen, and overseas sales subsidiaries in Singapore, Japan, the US, and Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying critical semiconductor fabrication equipment and related consumables to downstream semiconductor manufacturers. It also invests in key component suppliers and emphasizes localization of supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technology leadership in plasma etching and MOCVD equipment, expanding thin film deposition and epitaxial growth capabilities, and developing new products for emerging markets such as advanced packaging, MEMS, Mini-LED, Micro-LED, and power semiconductors including Si-based GaN and SiC devices. The company plans to launch over 10 new thin film deposition products in 2024 and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with 20.15% of revenue spent on R&D in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including etching machines, MOCVD systems, thin film deposition equipment, and related spare parts and services. The company uses a direct sales model globally, supplemented by agency sales in Europe. It also earns income from equipment support services and sales of consumables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of plasma etching and MOCVD equipment, competing against established global players from the US, Europe, and Japan. It holds a significant market share in China and has penetrated advanced logic and memory chip production lines internationally, including 5nm and below nodes. It is the largest supplier of GaN-based LED MOCVD equipment globally and is expanding into emerging semiconductor equipment markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 6.26 billion, a 32.15% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.79 billion, up 52.67%. The company has shown consistent high growth over the past decade with an average annual revenue growth rate exceeding 35%. Total assets reached RMB 21.53 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders was RMB 17.83 billion, reflecting steady expansion and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced technology, high product reliability, and strong customer service as key differentiators. Its plasma etching equipment supports ultra-high aspect ratio etching critical for advanced 3D NAND and logic chips, while its MOCVD systems lead in GaN-based LED and power device markets with superior throughput and uniformity. The company’s dual-chamber designs, adjustable plasma parameters, and energy-efficient innovations provide customers with cost-effective, high-performance solutions tailored to advanced semiconductor manufacturing needs.
